Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game scene atlas. Create ONE square 2048x2048 image with an EXACT 4 by 4 grid of equal square panels, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Absolutely no gutters, borders, labels or text. Each panel must be a separate fully contained illustration, with no objects crossing cell edges. Style: polished richly shaded adventure pixel-art scenes, crisp fine pixels, cinematic lighting, teal expedition clothing, detailed environments, matching a retro cooperative expedition game. The challenge itself must dominate the scene and be instantly recognizable; never substitute people planning, a shop or generic crew portraits. At most two small explorers witnessing the hazard when appropriate. Each panel's environment must match the specified biome. Depict the unresolved challenge, not an already successful solution. For indoor challenges show the specific broken mechanism, vault, records or bomb; windows/doorways can hint at biome. 
Environment for every occupied panel: Arctic Tundra. Ocean scenes: ocean surface for travel/waves/rafts, underwater research-base interiors for repairs/systems, underwater reef for reef challenges. Volcano scenes: volcanic basalt and lava outdoors; heat-shielded research-base interiors for indoor tasks.
Panel 1 (row 1, column 1): Frozen Lake. Scene requirement: A frozen lake separates your from your destination. You'll need to cross it, but be careful. The ice can be thin in places.
Panel 2 (row 1, column 2): Rockfall. Scene requirement: Your team finds themselves next to a steep slope. There's a crash and you team looks up to find that some rocks have come loose and are headed your way.
Panel 3 (row 1, column 3): Find Civilization. Scene requirement: Your team has been out in the open for too long. You'll need to find your way back to civilization if you have any hope of continuing your mission.
Panel 4 (row 1, column 4): Repair Enviro-Dome. Scene requirement: Your base has sustained damage to it's enviro-dome, housing numerous samples your team has collected from their time here. You'll need to work fast, but carefully to repair it, before the samples become impacted.
Panel 5 (row 2, column 1): Repair Rover. Scene requirement: Your friendly little rover 'Georgie' has suffered damage to his chassis and some of his internal mechanisms in a recent rockfall. You'll need it to be in working condition if you hope to collect any more samples before they are destroyed by changing outside conditions.
Panel 6 (row 2, column 2): Repair Vehicle. Scene requirement: There is a nearby base that your team needs to gather supplies from. Unfortunately, the vehicle that your team uses to make trips has suffered damage to its chassis and some of its internal mechanisms and will need to be repaired.
Panel 7 (row 2, column 3): Collapsed Bridge. Scene requirement: Your team comes across a bridge that has collapsed. You'll need to cross over it to progress.
Panel 8 (row 2, column 4): Dam. Scene requirement: A dam stands between you and your destination. Guards patrol the fenced off dam wall. You'll need to find a way over or around it if you want to continue your mission.
Panel 9 (row 3, column 1): Break into the Vault. Scene requirement: The item you seek is stored inside a vault. It's locked with a combination. You'll need to find a way inside if you want to retrieve the item.
Panel 10 (row 3, column 2): Pickpocket it. Scene requirement: You watch as an armed guard takes the item and slips it into their pocket for safe keeping. You'll need to find a way to get it off them
Panel 11 (row 3, column 3): Open the Document Case. Scene requirement: The target item you need is sealed inside a portable case with a mechanical lock.
Panel 12 (row 3, column 4): Central Heating Offline. Scene requirement: The central heating system has gone offline. You'll need to fix it if you don't want to freeze to death.
Panel 13 (row 4, column 1): Communications System Failure. Scene requirement: The communications system is offline. As the base is so large and sprawling, it's going need to be fixed if the base is to remain useable.
Panel 14 (row 4, column 2): Disable the Bomb Controls. Scene requirement: Your team reaches the bomb, but its safety controls have been damaged. The countdown is running. You'll need suitable equipment to restore the controls and shut it down.
Panel 15 (row 4, column 3): Destroy the Stolen Records. Scene requirement: Your team locates the enemy's only copies of your confidential records. They are stored as paper documents inside an archive room. You'll need to destroy them before the guards return.
Panel 16 (row 4, column 4): Shut Down the Weapon. Scene requirement: The enemy's super weapon is charging. Your team reaches its emergency controls, but the shutdown mechanism is jammed. You'll need suitable tools to release it.
